# SAEngine SDK reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/gen_sdk_reference.py: do not edit by hand. -->

Python API version **1.0.0** (`saengine.api.API_VERSION`). The guide, the versioning rules and examples are in [README.md](README.md).

## Python API (`saengine.api`)

### class `BuildingSpec`

`saengine.library.generator.BuildingSpec`: What :func:`generate_building` builds.

### class `CodePackError`

`saengine.codes.registry.CodePackError`: A pack cannot be loaded (unknown id, or it or its parents have errors).

### class `CodedTemplate`

`saengine.codes.contents.CodedTemplate`: A structure template whose geometry is made by the package's own Python (round M5): a new shape kind (a bridge, a tower, a hypar...). ``generator`` names a function of the package's ``hooks`` file, ``generator(params) -> geometry``, which runs only when the package is trusted; ``parameters`` is the JSON Schema of its parameters (the Generate panel's form is made from it) and ``values`` their starting values. The geometry enters the model through the same ``insert`` as a built-in shape's.

### class `Geometry`

`saengine.library.shapes.Geometry`: Elements ready to go into a structural model, with notes on what was left out.

### class `PackInfo`

`saengine.codes.manifest.PackInfo`: A pack found on disk, for the pack list (``saengine codepack list``, the Code Packs page).

### class `PackManifest`

`saengine.codes.manifest.PackManifest`: ``pack.json``: what the pack is, which pack it builds on and which tables it provides.

### class `ShapeInput`

`saengine.library.shapes.ShapeInput`: What the modeller's Generate panel edits: one shape.

### `active_code_pack(settings: 'Any' = None, project_root: 'Path | None' = None) -> 'CodePack'`

`saengine.codes.registry.active`

### `building_templates(project_root: 'Path | None' = None, registry: 'Registry | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.codes.catalogue.building_templates`: ``{templates: [{package, packageName, version, scope, file, name, description, type: 'spec' | 'archive', spec?, path?, author?}], problems: [...]}``. A spec template carries its building specification (as written in ``spec.json``, validated); an archive template its absolute path, opened through *New Project...* > *Start from*.

### `coded_geometry(package: 'str', file: 'str', values: 'dict[str, Any] | None' = None, project_root: 'Path | None' = None, registry: 'Registry | None' = None, member_type: 'str | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.codes.coded.coded_geometry`: The geometry of the coded template ``file`` of ``package`` with ``values`` over its starting values: :meth:`Geometry.to_json`, or ``{"problems": [...]}`` (with ``"untrusted": true`` when the package's code is not trusted, so the panel can say where to trust it). ``member_type``: the object type that replaces the placeholder type ``MEMBER`` (the Generate panel's current member type), as for the built-in shapes.

### `export_project(root: 'str | Path', out_path: 'str | Path', include_results: 'bool' = False, include_versions: 'bool' = False, include_exports: 'bool' = True, note: 'str | None' = None, statuses: 'Mapping[str, Any] | None' = None, saengine_version: 'str | None' = None, created: 'datetime | str | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.project.archive.export_project`: Archive the project at ``root`` into ``out_path`` (a ``.civil`` file, replaced if it exists): ``{"path", "size", "files": count, "skipped": [{"path", "reason"}], "problems"}``.

### `generate_building(spec: 'BuildingSpec | dict[str, Any]', settings: 'Any' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.library.generator.generate_building`: The parts of a building generated from ``spec`` (a :class:`BuildingSpec` or its JSON).

### `import_project(path: 'str | Path', dest_parent: 'str | Path', name: 'str | None' = None, overwrite: 'bool' = False, current_version: 'str | None' = None, migrate: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.project.archive.import_project`: Extract the archive ``path`` into ``<dest_parent>/<name>`` (default name: the archived project's): ``{"root", "name", "files": count, "problems" (warnings), "migrated": [...] (:func:`run_migrations`, unless not ``migrate``), "pending": [...] (:func:`pending_migrations`), "renamed"?: {"from", "to"}}``.

### `insert_geometry(model: 'StructuralModel', geometry: 'Geometry') -> 'tuple[StructuralModel, list[str], int]'`

`saengine.library.shapes.insert`: ``model`` with ``geometry`` added: (new model, ids of the new elements, how many were already there and left out). Points within 1 mm count as the same point.

### `inspect_archive(path: 'str | Path', current_version: 'str | None' = None, verify: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.project.archive.inspect_archive`: Read and check the archive ``path`` without extracting it: ``{"manifest" (None if it has none), "problems", "ok": no error, "files": count, "size": bytes once extracted}``.

`saengine.library.shapes.shape_geometry`: The members, panels and supports of ``shape``, placed in the model.

### `structure_presets(project_root: 'Path | None' = None, registry: 'Registry | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'`

`saengine.codes.catalogue.structure_presets`: ``{presets: [{package, packageName, version, scope, file, name, description, shape}], problems: [{package, file, message}]}``, sorted by package then name.

### `template_problems(path: 'str | Path', author: 'str' = '') -> 'list[dict[str, Any]]'`

`saengine.project.archive.template_problems`: Why the archive ``path`` cannot be a full building template (round M4): it is not inputs only (:func:`inputs_only_problems`), it places the site more precisely than a town (a latitude or longitude with more than :data:`TEMPLATE_COORDINATE_DECIMALS` decimals, or a plot outline), or a drawing or project file names a person other than the template's ``author`` (drawn by, checked by, client...). Empty when it may be published and opened as a template.

`saengine.codes.registry.set_trusted`

### `validate_package(path: 'Path', project_root: 'Path | None' = None) -> 'PackInfo'`

`saengine.codes.registry.validate`

## JSON-RPC methods

`python -m saengine.rpc.server` speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio with LSP framing (`Content-Length` headers). Parameters in **bold** are required; *worker* methods run in a worker thread, so long calls do not block the others.

| Method | Parameters | Handler | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ai/searchCode` | **query**, projectRoot, limit, docs | `ai_search_code` (worker) | The passages of the code pack in force (and the manual) that best match ``query``, each with its clauses (``saengine.ai.knowledge.search_code``): ``{pack, query, found, passages, note}``. The AI assistant answers code questions only from these; ``found`` False means the pack does not cover the question. |
| `architecture/check` | **architectureText**, floorPlanText | `architecture_check` | Problems of the architecture, with its rooms' net floor outlines and areas: ``{"problems", "rooms": {id: {"outline", "area"}}}`` (areas in m²). |
| `architecture/importDrawing` | **path**, architectureText, **floorPlanText**, options | `architecture_import_drawing` (worker) | Adopts an architect's DWG/DXF plan (walls, doors, windows, room names) onto one story: ``{"architecture": <json>, "summary": {"adopted", "skipped", "notes", "replaced"}}`` or ``{"problems"}``. ``options``: see ``saengine.library.architecture_dxf.import_drawing``. |
| `architecture/importIfc` | **path**, architectureText, **floorPlanText** | `architecture_import_ifc` (worker) | Adopts an architect's IFC (walls, doors, windows, spaces) into the architecture: ``{"architecture": <json>, "summary": {"adopted", "skipped", "notes"}}`` or ``{"problems"}``. |
| `architecture/inspectDrawing` | — | `architecture_inspect_drawing` (worker) | An architect's DWG/DXF for the layer-mapping step: its layers (entity counts, block names, sample texts), unit and a preview (``saengine.library.architecture_dxf.inspect_drawing``), or ``{"problems"}``. |
| `architecture/ramps` | **architectureText**, settingsText | `architecture_ramps` | Every ramp of the architecture checked against the ramp rules of the code pack the settings choose (``saengine.design.ramps.check_ramps``), or ``{"problems"}``. |
| `bim/generate` | **floorPlanText**, bimText | `generate_building` | The building model generated from the floor plan, keeping the model's own elements. |
| `bim/generateFromStructure` | **structureText**, bimText | `generate_building_from_structure` | The building model of a special structure, keeping the model's own elements. |
| `bim/ifc` | **bimText**, **objectsText**, materialsText, substructureText, settingsText, mepText, architectureText, name | `building_ifc` | The IFC of the building model: ``{"text", "ids", "skipped"}`` or ``{"problems"}``. |
| `bim/ifcRebar` | **bimText**, **objectsText**, materialsText, substructureText, settingsText, mepText, architectureText, name, projectRoot | `building_ifc` (worker) | The IFC of the building model: ``{"text", "ids", "skipped"}`` or ``{"problems"}``. |
| `boq/compute` | **bimText**, **objectsText**, **materialsText**, substructureText, settingsText, mepText, projectRoot, architectureText | `compute_boq` | The bill of quantities (``10 BOQ/boq.json`` text) of the building model, the substructure, the MEP plinths and sleeves, the plumbing (tanks, pipes, fixtures) and the architecture (brickwork, plaster, finishes, doors and windows): ``{"text", "notes"}``, or ``{"problems"}`` when an input has errors. ``project_root``: where the plumbing tanks' last designs are read from (their bars), and the architecture when ``architecture_text`` is not given. |
| `boq/cost` | **boqText**, ratesText, carbonText | `cost_boq` | The bill priced by the schedule of rates, with its embodied carbon (``saengine.boq.costing``): ``{"costing", "sampleRates"}`` or ``{"problems"}``. |
| `boq/exportXlsx` | **path**, **boqText**, ratesText, carbonText, settingsText, title | `export_boq_xlsx` (worker) | The bill, its costing and embodied carbon written to an Excel workbook (``saengine.boq.workbook``); ``settings_text``: the project settings, for the display units of the bill (C13; SI without). |
| `boq/templates` | — | `boq_templates` | The texts a project's ``10 BOQ/rates.json`` and ``carbon-factors.json`` start from: the sample schedule (made-up rates) and the carbon factors shipped. |
| `cad/cleanDxf` | — |  |  |
| `cad/convertDwg` | **path**, cache | `convert_dwg` (worker) | A DWG drawing as DXF (``saengine.library.dwg``): ``{"ok", "dxf", "warnings", "cached"}``, or ``{"ok": False, "code", "message"}`` (``code`` ``"no-converter"`` or ``"failed"``). |
| `cad/convertPdf` | **path**, page, cache, pagesOnly | `convert_pdf` (worker) | One page of an architect's PDF as DXF (``saengine.library.pdf_underlay``): ``{"ok", "dxf", "page", "pages", "vector", "size", "segments", "warnings", "cached", "scale"}``, or ``{"ok": False, "code": "failed", "message"}``; with ``pages_only`` only ``{"ok", "pages"}`` (read without converting a page: the page picker asks it first). |
| `cad/convertPointCloud` | — | `convert_point_cloud` (worker) | Alpha 9 L2: a plan slice of a scan as DXF with its traced lines (``saengine.library.point_cloud.convert``). |
| `cad/pointCloudView` | — | `point_cloud_view` (worker) | Alpha 9 L2: the scan decimated for the 3D view (``point_cloud.view_points``). |

| `codes/areaLoads` | **settingsText**, root | `codes_area_loads` | W4A-22: the project's area loads with the live loads of the code pack the settings choose (:func:`saengine.library.settings.area_loads_from_pack`): ``{id, name, areaLoads, changed, fromPack}``, ``changed`` the ids whose live load differs from the pack's, ``fromPack`` whether none does; or a refusal. |

| `codes/codedGeometry` | **package**, **file**, values, root, memberType | `codes_coded_geometry` (worker) | The geometry of a coded structure template (:func:`saengine.codes.coded.coded_geometry`), to preview and insert like a built-in shape's; ``{problems}`` when it cannot be made. |
| `codes/combinations` | **settingsText**, root | `codes_combinations` | W4A-2: the strength combinations the code pack the settings choose (unsaved edits included, ``settings_text``; with the project's overrides) generates for the project (:func:`saengine.library.settings.project_strength_combinations`): ``{id, name, combinations, fromPack}``, ``fromPack`` whether the settings' combinations are those already; or a refusal. |
| `codes/install` | **path**, root, scope, replace | `codes_install` (worker) | Copies a pack folder or .zip into the user's packs or the project's: its info. ``replace``: an installed package of the same id and scope is replaced (an update). |

| `codes/trust` | **id**, root, kind, what, trusted | `codes_trust` | Trusts (or stops trusting) the hooks of the package in force with this id and kind (a design code by default; a structure template's coded templates, round M5); with ``what`` "lookup" (alpha 9 C26), the online hazard lookup services its pack names. |
| `codes/validate` | **path**, root | `codes_validate` | The pack in ``path`` resolved against the installed packs, with its problems and the authoring warnings of :func:`saengine.codes.template.validate_pack`. |

| `components/list` | — | `installer_components` (worker) | The setup's optional components the backend runs, found as the backend finds them for use (``find_energyplus``, ``find_converter``): ``{"energyplus", "libredwg"}``, each ``{"state": "installed" \| "elsewhere" \| "missing", "path"?}``. ``installed``: the component's copy in the app folder; ``elsewhere``: another copy (the environment variable, an installed program), which works too. LibreCAD is found by the workbench (``findCadProgram``). |
